title: Salary delay → split promise
summary: Rohan can pay part today and the rest after salary. The agent captures a dated promise, sends the UPI link and schedules a reminder.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Namaste, I'm Ananya, Axis Bank's AI assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mr. Mehta?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, Rohan speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. To protect your account, could you confirm the last four digits of the PAN registered with us?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The last four digits are 4 8 2 1.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Your EMI of ₹7,840 was due on 11 October and is now 12 days overdue. I'm calling to help you clear it or find a plan. What's making it difficult to pay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: My salary is delayed this month, so I can't clear the full EMI today.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I understand. Salary timing can make a clean payment hard. Would it help to split it: a part payment today, and the rest on 27 October?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay ₹4,000 today, and the rest on the 27th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That works. I can send a secure UPI link for ₹4,000 now, and set the remaining ₹3,840 for 27 October. I'll also send a reminder 24 hours before. Would you like the link on WhatsApp?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, WhatsApp is fine.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Done. I've noted ₹4,000 today and ₹3,840 by 27 October. I'm sending the secure UPI link and a WhatsApp confirmation now, with a reminder 24 hours before. Is there anything else I can help with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all. Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Mr. Mehta. I appreciate your time. Goodbye.

title: Job loss → hardship handoff
summary: Meera has lost her job. The agent stops payment pressure, explains the next step and books a specialist callback at 5 pm.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Namaste, I'm Ananya, Axis Bank's AI assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Ms. Nair?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, Meera speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. To protect your account, could you confirm the last four digits of the PAN registered with us?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Your EMI of ₹12,450 was due on 9 October and is now 14 days overdue. I'm calling to help you clear it or find a plan. What's making it difficult to pay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I lost my job last month. I can't afford the EMI right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry you're going through that. I won't push for a payment today. I can connect you with a specialist who can check EMI restructuring or a suitable plan. Would a callback today at 5 pm work?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, 5 pm works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I've arranged a callback for 5 pm today. A specialist will review EMI restructuring and other options with you. I've paused automated reminders in the meantime. Take care.

title: Payment already made → trace opened
summary: Neha has already paid yesterday through UPI. The agent pauses reminders, avoids a duplicate payment request, and sends a verification prompt.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Namaste, I'm Ananya, Axis Bank's AI assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Ms. Vasanth?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Your EMI of ₹9,300 was due on 8 October and is now 18 days overdue. I'm calling to help you clear it or find a plan. What's making it difficult to pay?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Actually, I already paid it yesterday through UPI.

turns.speaker: agent

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Ms. Vasanth. I appreciate your time. Goodbye.
